items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed, with security-sensitive releases and new public exposure blocked. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable. Authentication/access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. TLS has no recorded certificates expiring within 30 days, but this is not proof of complete TLS coverage. Compliance also reports 20 failed and 6 unknown sites. Keep ordinary reversible growth permitted only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing read-only security evidence matrix; do not create duplicate telemetry or production work.

Retain the existing security evidence matrix and private launch gates. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS coverage, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. No credential access, permission changes, configuration changes, deployment, dependency additions, exploitation, or external disclosure outreach.

SearchWoot remains blocked for public beta or full launch because security and release evidence is incomplete, alongside unresolved rights, privacy, accuracy, and measurement gates. Exact recommendation: keep private and preview-only until the consolidated evidence matrix is complete and an owner-approved exception includes Security review.
